framings.description: Name one of FOUR's four points in another reading family (knowledge, told, truth, extremal), given its name in any family.

framings.description: Join two FOUR readings under the truth order: which way the pair leans.

framings.title: Reading Negate
framings.description: Negate one FOUR reading: exchange told-for and told-against.

framings.title: Reading Conflate
framings.description: Conflate one FOUR reading: exchange told-neither and told-both, fixing held and denied.

framings.title: SEN Utter
framings.description: Admit a token Mark and a claim Mark as one utterance: the boundary morphism that gets data into the SignCell/SignGraph/SignCraft pipeline.

framings.title: SEN Articulate
framings.description: Articulate an utterance as its reflexive SignCell: the cell told for by its own token.

framings.title: SEN Predicate
framings.description: Generate the SignGraph predication site a SignCell generates.

framings.title: SEN Posit
framings.description: Posit a valuation (the cells told) over a SignGraph predication site, to the presheaf they make.

framings.title: SEN Settle
framings.description: Settle a posited SignGraph presheaf to its SignCraft least fixed point: the coordination-free settlement of what was told.

framings.title: SEN Induce Relation
framings.description: The whole pipeline in one call: settle the relation one utterance articulates (utter, articulate, predicate, posit, and settle, composed).

framings.title: SEN Relate Relations
framings.description: Relate two settled relations: re-settle their joined cells as one relation.

framings.title: SEN Coincide
framings.description: Judge whether two Mark payloads coincide as token carriers: a witness or an obstruction.

framings.title: SEN Canonicalize
framings.description: Re-encode a JSON carrier in canonical form: the identity morphism on the JSON wire, witnessing representation-independence.

framings.title: SEN Type Inference
framings.description: The one Semiotic Expression Notation type of a closed SEN term, with the content address of the (term, type) judgment; open, malformed and untypable terms are refused before payment.

framings.title: SEN Reading Conflation
framings.description: SignChain's conflation of one reading, by its extremal name: exchange unknown and contested, fixing held and denied.

framings.title: Content Address
framings.description: The exact, deterministic content id of one JSON value under one named object kind (SHA-256 over its canonical SEN encoding): the same value and kind always produce the same address.

framings.title: JSON Schema Validate
framings.description: Validate one JSON value against one JSON Schema document (2020-12), with an optional corpus of referenced schemas; reports every violation, not just the first.

framings.title: Attention Allocation

framings.title: Reference Check
framings.description: Check up to 25 citation strings or CSL-JSON items against CrossRef and OpenAlex for DOI/scholarly records and Open Library for ISBN/book records. framings.title: Structural Claim Option Value
